backend/main.mo: Defines actor logic for user profiles, stats, availability, chat messages, and authorization with helper modules and several query methods.
feature_evidence.json: Describes a feature update requiring PWA manifest icons to use a specific external image URL, listing affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend source files for reference or documentation needs.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and global styling rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file configuring metadata, PWA manifest link, icons, and mounting the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata and icons, all pointing to the provided external image URL.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component configuring authentication gating, layout, and all TanStack Router routes.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI component showing an admin-only access restriction message with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen using Internet Identity with background image, branding, and sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple component rendering the app logo from configured branding values.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Chat UI that loads recent messages, displays user avatars, handles scrolling, and submits new messages.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level page layout with header, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Navigation bar that highlights the active route and conditionally shows an admin link.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Top bar showing app branding, theme toggle, PWA install button, and user menu with logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Profile editor allowing name changes and profile picture upload with validations and progress.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the caller’s leaderboard rank or a loading skeleton.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user’s match history with wins and losses, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting the user to enter their name on first setup.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a faint fixed background image layer.
Renders a user avatar with initials fallback and their display name in various sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and update the caller’s user profile using react-query and actor APIs.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Defines hooks to retrieve the caller’s user role and check admin status via actor queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth provider and hook to manage identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Manages PWA install prompt availability and triggers the installation flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains multiple react-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability, leaderboard data, and match history.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Tracks and toggles light/dark theme, syncing preference to localStorage and document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Provides hooks to fetch display names and avatars for principals, building user directory maps.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports app branding constants including name and logo URL.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Offers utilities for converting between dates and bigint IDs, formatting dates, and generating calendar grids.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page to add or edit a user's availability with time and notes, preloading existing data if present.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for managing users and availabilities, including deletion and viewing sorted lists.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view showing days with availability and navigation between months, plus embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page wrapper displaying the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Displays all availabilities for a specific day with options to add, edit, or delete the user's own entry.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard with ranking changes, win/loss recording, and day selection based on user availability.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing account details, leaderboard ranking, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides utilities to convert files to Uint8Array and derive initials for avatar fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides helper functions to generate time unit options, format and parse time strings, and supply default time components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Offers utilities for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using both query strings and hash-based routing with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project state metadata describing a PWA manifest icon update to use an external image URL and tracks related feature requests.
